lines.text: REBUTTAL TO ARGUMENT AGAINST MEASURE BB
What does an organization led by a Morgan Hill resident know about Pacifica? Nothing.
When the next natural disaster strikes, will the Silicon Valley Taxpayers' Association come to Pacifica's rescue?
If you want Pacifica to be ready for the next coastal, wildfire, or earthquake emergency, then don't listen
to political rhetoric. Vote YES on BB.
If you're worried about coastal erosion and Pacifica's seawall, vote YES on BB so our City has the resources to
make it through the next emergency. Every dime of Measure BB STAYS RIGHT HERE IN PACIFICA for
the services we all rely on.
If you're angry about City budget cuts resulting from federal and state funding cuts: vote YES on BB. NO money
can be taken by the State or the County.
YES on BB maintains 911 emergency medical response times, firefighter and police services.
YES on BB helps repairs streets in the worst condition, maintain storm drains to prevent flooding; and keep parks,
beaches and public spaces safe and maintained.
Measure BB requires public spending reports, community oversight and annual independent financial audits to
Measure BB isn't a tax on your home or property
Measure BB doesn't apply to groceries or prescription medications.
The choice is clear: allow Pacifica's infrastructure backlog to grow and risk additional cuts to essential
— or protect the City and public safety services that keep our community safe from the next

Ballot Measure Rebuttal Argument Submission Form
If both an argument in favor of and an argument against a measure have been selected for publication in the Sample
Ballot & Official Voter Information Pamphlet, a typed rebuttal to the argument in favor of or the argument against the
measure may be submitted as outlined in this form.
The author(s) of the primary argument of the measure may prepare and submit a rebuttal argument or may authorize
in writing any other person or persons to prepare, submit or sign the rebuttal argument.
A rebuttal argument will not be accepted unless accompanied by this completed form, which shall contain the printed
name(s) and signature(s) of the person(s) submitting it or, if submitted on behalf of a bona fide association of citizens,
the name of the association and the printed name and signature of at least one of its principal officers. Please make
sure you are using proper format before submitting to the Elections Office.
Word count limit for Rebuttal Arguments = 250 words
